# Zenium

Zenium is a utility intelligence company helping utilities turn metering and operational data into actionable intelligence, built on a trusted Head-End System (HES) and Meter Data Management System (MDMS) foundation.

Website: https://www.zenium.ai

## Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI)

Scalable Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) software platform. Hardware-agnostic Head-End System (HES), Meter Data Management System (MDMS), and analytics for smart grid distribution utilities.

- Page: https://www.zenium.ai/solutions/advanced-metering-infrastructure-ami

## Head-End System (HES)

Enterprise Head-End System (HES) software for large-scale AMI rollouts. Vendor-agnostic DLMS/COSEM support, RF Mesh, and Cellular connectivity.

- Page: https://www.zenium.ai/solutions/head-end-system-hes

## Meter Data Management System (MDMS)

Enterprise Meter Data Management System (MDMS). Automate Validation, Editing, and Estimation (VEE), meter-to-cash billing determinants, prepayment, and energy theft detection.

- Page: https://www.zenium.ai/solutions/meter-data-management-system-mdms

## Energy management and analytics

Turn interval meter data into actionable intelligence. Transformer load profiling, non-technical loss analytics, and feeder balance monitoring.

- Page: https://www.zenium.ai/solutions/energy-management-analytics
